entries.headline: Five US transports and command aircraft reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported five US Air Force transport aircraft and a nuclear command-and-control aircraft airborne over the United States. It described the activity as heavier than normal without providing the comparison baseline.

entries.headline: War Watch relays missile-attack report concerning three Ukrainian locations
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a @reagan0965 report that Kyiv, Dnipro and Trypillia came under missile attack involving Iskander-M and Hwasong-11A ballistic missiles. The visible post is truncated before completing the reported weapon details and does not independently confirm the attack.

entries.headline: Two coded broadcasts and elevated Taiwan-area activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported two coded US Air Force radio broadcasts during the preceding hour, aircraft activity near Taiwan at nearly three times normal, and multiple high-priority military aircraft airborne over the United States. The post does not provide the comparison baseline or broadcast contents.

entries.headline: War Watch relays report of Ukrainian drone activity over western Russia
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a @reagan0965 report that a Ukrainian drone raid was under way over western Russia and cited local Russian channels. The visible post is truncated before completing the reported movement details and does not independently confirm the activity.

entries.headline: Six US transports and elevated coded-radio activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and coded radio broadcasts averaging seven per hour that day. It described the activity as above normal but the visible post is truncated before completing a reference to Middle East tensions.

entries.headline: War Watch relays report of Riyadh explosion and halted air traffic
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed an OSINTWarfare-attributed report that an explosion was heard in Riyadh following a reported Ansar Allah ballistic-missile attack and that air traffic had been halted. The post does not independently confirm the incident.

entries.headline: Coded broadcasts and six heavy transports reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported coded US Air Force radio broadcasts at nearly three times normal across nine regions worldwide and six heavy transport aircraft airborne. The visible post is truncated before completing the transport-location detail and does not provide its comparison baseline.

entries.headline: War Watch relays Newsmax report on NATO planning
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a Newsmax report that NATO was preparing a plan intended to cripple Russian forces in the event of an attack. The post does not provide the plan details or independent confirmation.

entries.headline: US command jet, cargo aircraft and one coded broadcast reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a US Air Force nuclear command aircraft and multiple cargo aircraft airborne over the United States, one coded radio broadcast during the preceding hour, and continuing activity near UK military bases.

entries.headline: War Watch relays US Embassy health alert concerning Irkutsk
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a report that the US Embassy in Moscow issued a health alert concerning a suspected pneumonic-plague case in Russia's Irkutsk region. The visible post is truncated after referring to a laboratory and does not provide further details.

entries.headline: Korea and Japan air activity reported at 3.2 times normal
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported military air activity near Korea and Japan at nearly 3.2 times normal and multiple transport and surveillance aircraft airborne over the United States. The visible post is truncated before completing a further reference to a US Navy helicopter.

entries.headline: US transports and elevated Korea-Japan air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported US military transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and air activity near Korea and Japan at nearly three times the usual level. The post does not provide the comparison baseline.

entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a US-registered military P-8 near Ninohe, Japan. The callsign was shown as NA; the alert does not establish its destination or operational purpose.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on L-39 Skyfox counter-drone upgrade
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a The Aviationist report that Aero Vodochody and Thales are equipping the L-39 Skyfox with a 70 mm laser-guided rocket pod for counter-drone use. The post does not state the test or deployment status.

entries.headline: US E-6 airborne alert at Suisun

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on BAE F-35 electronic-warfare order
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that BAE Systems received an order from Lockheed Martin to supply electronic-warfare systems for F-35 production Lots 20 through 22. The post does not state the order value or delivery schedule.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on first F-16 Block 72 flight
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a The War Zone report that the first F-16 Block 72 completed its maiden flight and identified Morocco as the launch customer. The post does not provide further flight details.
